title: A Orbit for the Echo
author: Wren Okafor
blurb: Astrid Vasquez, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
